note: User-referral platform for SaaS, Munich (founded 2022). 'A preempted Seed round led by HV Capital' of EUR 3.1M ($3.5M), July 2023 (tech.eu; Business Insider). No later round on any surface.

Conversational commerce on WhatsApp, Berlin (founded 2019). HV entered 2021-03 (Fund VIII), the month of the $6.5M seed Accel led (Accel's own page); no source read here names HV in that round. The $20M Series A of July 2022 (Salesforce Ventures; the firm-name search) followed.

Digital coaching platform, Berlin (founded 2018). HV entered 2019-06 (Fund VII); the round is not named on the surfaces read. $30M in Dec 2020 and the $80M 'B2' of Sept 2021 with HV; $200M Series C (Sofina, SoftBank) in June 2022, no priced valuation published.

Marketplace for independent food makers (Depop's founder Simon Beckerman), London (founded 2020). HV entered 2021-01 (Fund VIII), in the GBP 2.5M launch funding announced Dec 2021 (Tech Funding News, found by the firm-name search), not named as a series; Balderton's GBP 6M seed of Sept 2022 followed.

Virtual care for employers, Montreal (founded 2016). HV entered 2017-12 (Fund VI); the round is not named. $40M in June 2019, Sun Life led $43M in 2020; TSX IPO March 2021; acq. by Sun Life, 2023 (the firm's export: acquired).

AI energy procurement and management for industry, Munich (founded 2022). HV entered 2023-03 (Fund IX Ventures); that round is not named. EQT Ventures led the EUR 16M Series A of Jan 2025 with HV. The Wikidata country CZ belongs to a namesake and is disputed.
Refill cleaning tablets, Munich (founded 2019). HV entered 2020-09 (Fund VII), before the $21.8M Series A Felix Capital led in Feb 2021 (TechCrunch); HV's round is not named.

Agrivoltaic solar systems, Munich (founded 2024). HV entered at the EUR 1.7M round of Nov 2024 (the firm's own news feed links EU-Startups' report), not named as a series; a EUR 10M+ seed followed in Sept 2025 (tech.eu).

Mobile vets and pet-health clinics, Berlin (founded 2019). HV entered 2020-07 (Fund VII); tech.eu's report of the Jan 2021 Series A (Redalpine led) names 'previous backers HV Capital and 468 Capital', so HV's round came before it and is not named.

Wholesale marketplace for secondhand clothing (YC Winter 2022; the firm's HQ field San Francisco). 'HV Capital led the Series A' of $14.8M, announced with a $5.6M a16z-led seed in Nov 2024 (WWD, TechCrunch, businesscloud); a $25M Series B followed in July 2026.

Autonomous legal agents (Legal OS, renamed Flank), Berlin (founded 2018). HV led Legal OS's $2.2M round of June 2019 ('led by HV Holtzbrinck Ventures', Artificial Lawyer), not named as a series; Insight Partners led a $10M round of June 2025. The old 'LEGAL OS' row is this company (merge at the rebuild).

Heating-system optimisation software for housing companies, Berlin (founded 2021; the firm's HQ field names the state, Brandenburg). HV's entry (HV Entry 2024; the archived list's date 2025-10-25 is a data error, later than the capture that carries it) is the EUR 12M round of Jan 2025 (EU-Startups, found by the firm-name search), not named as a series in the headline.
AI software-engineering agent, London (founded 2023). 'A GBP 6.3M Seed round led by HV Capital' (tech.eu, 2024-10-30). Entered 2024-10: inside the 24-month window.

Open-banking API, London (founded 2017). HV entered 2018-07 (Fund VII), before the $5.4M round of May 2019 (TechCrunch); HV's round is not named. $13M Series A (Apr 2020, Lakestar), $51M Series B (July 2021, Sapphire) with HV.

AI sourcing software for procurement, Zurich (founded 2018, an ETH spin-off). HV led the $10M round of Sept 2021 ('The funding round led by HV Capital', Startupticker; the page names it the Series A; the firm's entry year 2021).

Payment operations platform, Berlin (founded 2021). HV is named in the $6.4M seed led by a16z (TechCrunch, 2022-03-17, the firm's own entry date); EUR 13.5M seed extension June 2023; the $32M Series A of June 2025 (tech.eu) graduates the row.
